name: hmi_patch_json
description: Validate or apply declarative Unified HMI JSON set/bind/delete operations with require and verify guards; changes are transactional, compiled, and never saved.

dry_run.description: Validate preconditions and report operations without applying them (default: false).

file_path.description: Path to a tia-mcp-hmi-patch/1 JSON patch file.

target_name.description: Target HMI software/device selector (optional when only one target exists).
